results.name: Plank Cross Knee Drive
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core.
Lift your right knee and drive it towards your left elbow and straighten your leg, twisting your torso slightly to the left as you do so.
Return your right leg to the starting plank position.
Repeat the movement with your left knee, driving it towards your right elbow. Alternate sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your core engaged throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Move slowly and with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you drive your knee towards your elbow and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Plank Cross Knee Drive is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Plank Jack
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core.
Jump your feet out to the sides, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, while keeping your upper body stable.
Quickly jump your feet back together to return to the starting plank position.
Continue jumping your feet in and out for the desired number of repetitions or duration.
tips: Move quickly but with control to maximize muscle engagement and prevent injury.
Maintain a neutral head position, looking slightly ahead of your hands, to keep your neck aligned with your spine.
Ensure your body stays in a straight line, avoiding sagging hips or raised buttocks.
results.description: Plank Jack is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: Plank Knee Tucks
instructions: Begin in a plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Quickly jump both knees towards your chest, landing with both feet flat on the floor beneath you.
Immediately jump your feet back to the starting plank position.
Continue jumping your feet in and out for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use controlled, explosive movements to quickly bring your knees to your chest and return to plank position.
Ensure your shoulders remain directly over your wrists to maintain alignment and reduce strain on your shoulders.
Keep your hips level throughout the movement to maintain proper form and avoid sagging or raising your hips.
results.description: Plank Knee Tucks is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.

results.name: Plank Reach Through
instructions: Begin in a side plank position on your right side with your right elbow supporting your body, your left arm raised vertically towards the ceiling, and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your left arm, reaching it under and across your torso while slightly lowering your hips.
Return your left arm to the starting position, lifting your hips back to the straight line.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the left side and repeat the movement with your right arm.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Ensure your supporting arm or elbow is directly under your shoulder to maintain proper alignment and reduce strain.
Keep your hips stable and aligned with your body, avoiding excessive rotation.
Focus on steady breathing, exhaling as you reach under your torso and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Plank Reach Through is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

results.name: Plank on Elbows
instructions: Begin by lying face down on the floor. Place your elbows directly under your shoulders and your forearms flat on the floor, parallel to each other.
Engage your core and lift your body off the floor, forming a straight line from your head to your heels. Your elbows and toes should support your body weight.
Hold this position, keeping your core tight and your body straight. Avoid letting your hips sag or rise too high.
Maintain the plank position for the desired amount of time, focusing on your form and breathing steadily.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maintain stability and support your lower back.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, avoiding any sagging or lifting of the hips.
Keep your shoulders directly above your elbows to maintain proper alignment and reduce strain on your shoulders.
results.description: Plank on Elbows is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Lower Back.

results.name: Plate Hollow Hold
instructions: Lie on your back holding a weight plate with both hands, arms extended above your chest.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your shoulders and straight legs off the ground.
Keep the plate steady above you in the hollow position.
Hold for the set time while breathing steadily, then lower with control.
tips: Raise your legs higher if your lower back starts to arch.
Keep your chin slightly tucked.
results.description: Plate Hollow Hold is an intermediate single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

results.name: Plate Pinch Grip Side Bend
instructions: Stand tall and pinch a weight plate in one hand at your side, fingers on one face and thumb on the other.
Place the other hand on your hip or behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the plate as far as you comfortably can, keeping your hips still.
Return to upright by contracting the opposite side of your waist, then switch sides after the set.
tips: Bend straight to the side; don't lean forward or back.
The pinch grip also trains your fingers and forearm.
results.description: Plate Pinch Grip Side Bend is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Core.

results.name: Plate Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and heels on the ground, holding a weight plate at your chest.
Lean back slightly with a straight back.
Rotate your torso to bring the plate to one side of your hips.
Rotate back through the centre to the other side and repeat.
tips: Lift your feet to make it harder.
Turn your shoulders, not just your arms.
results.description: Plate Russian Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Plate Situp
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, holding a weight plate on your chest.
Brace your core and curl your torso up until you are sitting upright.
Pause at the top.
Lower your back to the floor with control and repeat.
tips: Anchor your feet under something if they lift.
Don't pull with your neck; lead with your chest.
results.description: Plate Situp is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Plate Standing Twist
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a weight plate at chest height with your arms slightly bent.
Brace your core and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return through the centre with control and rotate to the other side.
tips: Keep the movement controlled; don't swing the plate.
Extending your arms further makes it harder.
results.description: Plate Standing Twist is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Abdominals, Shoulders.
